title: Reproduction-recipe step ablation and hidden-state dependency ledger
hypothesis: A bounded same-owner step-ablation matrix can show which declared recipe steps are causally necessary and can expose hidden state when removing or perturbing a step does not produce the preregistered failure or recovery behavior.
null_or_failure: A required step can be omitted without explanation, an undeclared cache changes output, environment state is read silently, ablation order changes results, hashes hide semantic divergence, a failed ablation is discarded, or same-owner parity is called independent reproduction.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Ablate checkout verification, manifest generation, JSON parsing, privacy scan, validator, report build, and hash comparison; perturb cache and environment declarations; require the expected fail-closed signal and retain all unexpected results.
rollback_or_recovery: Retain the divergent snapshot, declare the newly exposed dependency, restore the complete recipe without rewriting history, rerun in fresh detached D-drive snapshots, and keep independent-team reproduction open.
boundary: Same-owner detached snapshots are repeatability evidence, not independent-team reproduction.
